title: Pin that host source-text refusal runs after replay, so an exact retry of an earlier admission still replays
outcome: Pin that host source-text refusal runs after replay, so an exact retry of an earlier admission still replays
acceptance: A test persists an admitted turn_checkpoint, named_root_bind and execution_observe operation whose host source text holds a refused character (through a direct fixture, as an operation admitted before the rule), then repeats the exact intent and receives the stored receipt rather than that endpoint's text refusal (source_basis_text_refused, named_root_binding_refused or execution_observation_invalid); moving the check above replay makes it fail

completion.summary: Tests pin that the host source-text check runs after replay at turn_checkpoint, named_root_bind and execution_observe: an operation stored as if admitted before the rule (its stored intent rewritten to the request with a refused character) replays its receipt on the exact retry, while a fresh key is refused with the endpoint's code. ExecutionObserveIntent::of became pub(super) for the test. Store judgment: none; readiness ready on all 4 stores.
